items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: You ever hear that song? ... Fred Astaire made a recording of that with Benny Goodman’s band ... Great, great record

ctx.x: They were terrific. They were delicious. They were so good. A lot of times Benny Goodman was on the side and somebody else was conducting the band. I don’t remember who it was. He picked different guys to conduct the show for them dancers. One time he came out with his clarinet while they were dancing and he played the clarinet for them. It was so good. Do you have a record that Benny Goodman made with Fred Astaire called “Who Cares?” You ever hear that song?
